products.title: Your Forever Can
products.story: Match the room. Change the paper. Keep the can.
products.description: The patented wallpaper wastebasket by Patti Gilley. A clear outer shell, a rigid inner can, and a wallpaper insert you choose — so the pattern can match the room and change whenever the décor does. Sold as Your Forever Can on Etsy.
products.longDescription: Most decorative bins are glued once and done. The Forever Can is a system: a transparent outer receptacle, a stainless inner liner, a cutting template, and a retainer ring that holds your wallpaper in view without adhesive. Slip in leftover paper from the powder room, a favorite floral, or a custom print. When the room changes, the insert changes with it. Patented by Patricia H. Gilley of Wrightsville Beach, NC (US 2024/0327113 A1).
products.materials: Clear outer shell, rigid inner liner, wallpaper insert, retainer ring, cutting template
products.care: Wipe the shell. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.

products.title: Rose Garden
products.story: Blush roses on cream. Cottage powder-room energy.
products.description: A Forever Can dressed in English rose-garden wallpaper — full blooms, trailing greenery, warm cream ground. Ready to live beside a vanity or linen chest.
products.longDescription: Floral paper is how most Forever Cans begin. This insert is a classic rose garden: coral and blush blooms on cream, sealed behind the clear shell so the pattern reads as furniture, not trash. Pair it with leftover border paper or swap it for another floral when the season turns.
products.materials: Forever Can system with floral wallpaper insert
products.care: Wipe the shell. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.

products.title: Chinoiserie Grove
products.story: Birds, branches, celadon air. Grandmillennial, not dusty.
products.description: Indigo birds and blossoming branches on celadon — a chinoiserie grove for rooms that already collect porcelain, brass, and a little theater.
products.longDescription: Chinoiserie paper is the Forever Can’s most requested botanical. Birds and flowering limbs wrap the cylinder so the bin can sit next to a pagoda lamp or a skirted sink and look like it was always part of the plan. The insert is changeable; the can is not a one-pattern object.
products.materials: Forever Can system with chinoiserie wallpaper insert
products.care: Wipe the shell. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.

products.title: Lattice Geometry
products.story: Hard geometry for rooms that already have an opinion.
products.description: Cobalt, sun, and ink diamonds on paper beige. A graphic lattice for modern powder rooms that still want a handmade object.
products.longDescription: Not every Forever Can wants roses. Lattice Geometry is the graphic insert: interlocking diamonds in cobalt, sun yellow, and ink. It photographs like campaign furniture and lives well against terrazzo, walnut, and white tile. Same patented shell. Different paper.
products.materials: Forever Can system with geometric wallpaper insert
products.care: Wipe the shell. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.

products.title: Blush Damask
products.story: Studio pink. Baroque scroll. The house mark, in paper.
products.description: Blush damask with cream acanthus — the Instagram-pink Forever Can for rooms that already lean floral, satin, and a little extra.
products.longDescription: The house color is candy pink for a reason. Blush Damask wraps the cylinder in baroque scrollwork so the can reads as a dressing-table object. It is the closest ready-to-ship cousin of the circular wallpaper-wastebasket mark.
products.materials: Forever Can system with damask wallpaper insert
products.care: Wipe the shell. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.

products.title: Ink Toile
products.story: Pastoral ink on ivory. The quiet, graphic classic.
products.description: Black-and-cream toile scenes wrapping a Forever Can — trees, figures, and linework for dining rooms and traditional baths.
products.longDescription: Toile is wallpaper’s most literary pattern. This insert puts pastoral ink drawings on ivory so the can can sit on herringbone and look inherited. When the room wants a new chapter, the paper comes out and another one goes in.
products.materials: Forever Can system with toile wallpaper insert
products.care: Wipe the shell. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.
